select review_id, acm_name, content, user_id, created_at, rating from (SELECT r.REVIEW_ID review_id, a.acm_name acm_name, r.content content, r.user_id user_id, r.CREATED_AT created_at, r.RATING rating, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.review_id) AS rnum FROM ACCOMMODATION a JOIN REVIEW r ON a.acm_id = r.acm_id WHERE a.admin_id = #{admin_id}) where (rnum between #{startNum} and #{endNum})
AND INSTR(content, #{keyWord}) > 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_reviews FROM ACCOMMODATION a JOIN REVIEW r ON a.acm_id = r.acm_id WHERE a.admin_id = #{admin_id}
AND INSTR(content, #{keyWord}) > 0
